case.reviewStatus: Original fictional teaching case; independent clinician review pending.
case.title: Presentation title without the diagnosis
case.setting: Care setting and relevant regional pathway
case.patient: Fictional age and clinically relevant context
case.chiefComplaint: What the learner receives at handoff
case.history: History that may be opened before the first decision; no later results
case.exam: Examination findings available at this stage

stages.label: INITIAL APPROACH
stages.question: Decision justified by the currently available information?
stages.explanation: Why the best choice fits this stage, and why each alternative is less appropriate

stages.label: NEW FINDINGS
stages.content: New results with units, time, reference ranges when needed, and measurement limitations

stages.label: DIAGNOSIS
stages.question: Best working formulation after these findings?
stages.explanation: How the findings discriminate without claiming more certainty than they support

stages.label: MANAGEMENT
stages.question: Next action under the stated circumstances?
stages.explanation: Why this plan fits, legitimate alternatives, contraindications and unresolved questions

stages.label: FOLLOW-UP
stages.content: A later finding, response or change that matters for reassessment

stages.label: REASSESSMENT
stages.question: How does the new information change the plan?
stages.explanation: Explain the update without rewriting what was justified earlier

case.diagnosis: Final working formulation, including uncertainty where appropriate

modelNote.assessment: Synthesis of all findings through the final stage
modelNote.plan: Proportionate next steps, alternatives, follow-up and uncertainty

review.alternativesAndLimits: Reasonable alternatives, excluded contexts and claims the case cannot support
reviewQuestions: Is every keyed choice justified at its stage?
Are any legitimate alternatives incorrectly marked wrong?
Does the final note agree with the complete encounter?
